translation.title: Dexpanthenol (D-Panthenol) Cream
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for wounds, burns, torn skin (such as cracked nipples during breastfeeding), pressure sores (bedsores), acute and chronic dermatitis, eczema, skin ulcers, diaper rash and sunburn (solar dermatitis).
translation.usage: After cleaning the wound, apply it to the affected area once or several times a day. For cracked nipples during breastfeeding, apply it to the nipples right after each feeding. For diaper rash, apply it after changing the diaper.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, or if you have an infectious or exudative (oozing) skin disease. Avoid contact with the eyes. If you have applied this medicine to treat cracked nipples during breastfeeding, wipe it off before nursing. Adverse reactions may occur - very rarely, allergic reactions (contact dermatitis, allergic dermatitis, itching, redness, eczema, rash, hives, skin irritation, blisters); if any of these occur, stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Store at room temperature and keep out of reach of children.
